qa_cases.guidance: Use h2 scenario groups and h3 test cases. For each case include preconditions, test data, steps, expected result, and coverage notes when applicable.
qa_cases.hint: Name the behavior, add executable steps, and describe the observable result. Coverage notes are optional.

checklist.guidance: Use checklist items for executable checks. Keep each item directly testable and include expected results where useful.
checklist.hint: Write one executable check and its expected result per item.

gherkin.guidance: Use Feature/Scenario style content with Given/When/Then phrasing in h2, h3, p, ul, and ol elements.
gherkin.hint: Name the feature and scenario. Describe the starting state, action, and expected outcome after Given, When, and Then.

charters.guidance: Use exploratory charter sections with mission, scope, risks, setup/data, timebox, and notes to capture observations.
charters.hint: Describe the mission, scope, risks, setup, data, and timebox. Record observations as you explore.

coverage_outline.guidance: Start with a compact coverage map, then list the concrete cases needed to exercise each area.
coverage_outline.hint: Group the areas and risks to cover, then list concrete cases with steps and expected results.
